map.纯格式化不会改变语义，但要注意两点：一是注释里的优化器提示（如 /*+ INDE: Pure formatting does not change semantics, but watch two things: first, optimizer hints in comments (e.g., /*+ INDEX(...) */) may be moved or removed and directly affect the plan; second, in some dialects line-break position can affect meaning. map.先删除行注释（双横线到行尾）与块注释，再把连续空白压缩为单个空格并去掉首尾空白。: It first removes line comments (double hyphen to end of line) and block comments, then compresses consecutive whitespace into a single space and trims. It then replaces each clause keyword (SELECT, FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, HAVING, LIMIT, OFFSET, the various JOINs, UNION ALL, UNION, ON, VALUES, SET) in turn — matching word boundaries, case-insensitively, with internal spaces matched as whitespace — with "newline + uppercase keyword + newline + indent", and replaces each comma and the whitespace after it with "comma + newline + indent". It then processes line by line: lines starting with a major keyword are kept as-is, and other non-empty lines not already starting with the indent get the indent added. When keyword uppercasing is on, the keyword list is replaced word-wise, case-insensitively, with its uppercase form. Finally consecutive blank lines are merged and leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed
